description: Pitch and envelope follower: analyses an incoming sound in real time and puts out the pitch it finds as 1V/oct, along with an envelope tracking the level of the sound

params.text: Filters high frequencies out of the incoming sound before it is analysed, so that sibilants such as ss and ff are not detected as very high notes
Smooths the pitch output, taking out spikes and turning a step between two notes into a slide
Smooths the envelope output, taking out spikes and giving the level a fade-in and a fade-out
Sets the level of the envelope output, and with it the height of the envelope drawn on the panel

outputs.text: The detected fundamental of the incoming sound, as 1V/oct pitch
The envelope, following the level of the incoming sound

notes: the pitch display gives the note name and cents, the frequency, the output voltage, and the detection latency in milliseconds, which is shorter for higher notes
the module has nothing to follow until a sound is patched into its audio input; neither output moves on its own
